observations.behavior: Adds JWT-based authentication and a new encrypted-blocks endpoint to the recording API.
observations.posthog_connection: Recording API authentication and block encryption. P1.F4.H7 adds a write-only JWT route and its auth middleware, while P1.F4.H8 implements the encryptBlocks handler. P1.F2.H3 and P1.F2.H3 add requireJwt and its enforcement. P1.F3 and P1.F4 add the encryptBlocks endpoint and its tests.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a test and implementation change for session replay recording encryption. P1.F5 is a test-only chunk; P1.F6 and P1.F7 are implementation and schema. No tier assignment is made here; tier is assigned after reviewing the complete group.

observations.behavior: Adds sodium and crypto imports, including SodiumRecordingDecryptor and SodiumRecordingEncryptor, and an envUtils dependency.
observations.posthog_connection: These imports support the implementation of a new encryption capability for session replay recording blocks, using libsodium for cryptographic operations.

observations.behavior: Adds a SodiumRecordingEncryptor dependency to the RecordingService constructor and its mock in the test, alongside the existing ClickHouse credential.
observations.posthog_connection: This demonstrates the dependency of the recording service on a new encryption component, indicating the service now supports encrypted recording blocks.

observations.behavior: Adds a new describe block and several tests for the encryptBlocks method, including tests for existing recording, cleartext key, cloud key unavailability, and deleted session key scenarios.
observations.posthog_connection: These tests establish the expected behavior of the encryption and retrieval of recording blocks, including error handling for various states, which is critical for the reliability of the session replay feature.
